title: Decided or Open? Comparing Program Repair Techniques When Patch Correctness Is Unknown
data:
S Nafis - 2026
Comparisons of automated program repair (APR) techniques depend on knowing 
which patches are correct, but many patches are never checked and some archived 
test results are wrong. We propose reporting each comparison as decided or open.
